description: NHFLOW 2D open channel (h 0.3 m, U 0.6 m/s), discharge inflow and outflow, k-epsilon, van Rijn suspended load only (S 11 0, S 12 1), erodible bed for x >= 2 m (S 71). Suspended sediment leaves through the outflow.
covers: nhflow_suspended_IM1::suspsource (exchange only in the erodible region)
nhflow_suspended_IM1::bcsusp_start (implicit zero gradient at closed faces)
